metadata.description: NetIntel for Claude Code — pay-per-call network, domain, web and inference lookups over x402 (USDC on Base). No API keys; payments go through the agent’s own wallet.

plugins.name: netintel
plugins.description: 141 pay-per-call intelligence tools for agents — DNS, SSL, WHOIS, IP reputation, email verification, web fetch & search, an OpenAI-compatible gateway, embeddings and market data — paid per call in USDC over x402 from the agent’s own wallet (AgentCash, Coinbase Agentic Wallet or Coinbase Wallet MCP); the plugin never holds a key. Installs the netintel MCP server and a skill that knows which endpoint to use and what it costs.
